title: Open Problems on Billiards and Geometric Optics
exact_target: Find an odd-period reflective projective billiard with period at least five; for each period at least four, determine the examples within specified boundary regularity classes.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 5200006 (AMR-051-0006). CC BY 4.0.
M. Bialy, C. Fierobe, A. Glutsyuk, M. Levi, A. Plakhov and S. Tabachnikov, \emph{Open problems on billiards and geometric optics} (2021), arXiv:2110.10750v2, Corentin Fierobe, Problem 1, pp. 4--5.
